parts.text:
*(Sound effects: The rhythmic, metallic ticking of a pocket watch. Below, the low, mechanical drone of the city’s midnight transit hums beneath the wail of a distant siren. A cold wind whistles through the rusted ironwork, carrying with it a faint, unintelligible whisper.)*

*(I snap the pocket watch shut. 11:45 PM. Fifteen minutes to midnight.)*

"The plan," I mutter to the empty shadows of the rooftop overlooking the clock tower, "is to assume it’s a trap."

*(Sound effect: The sharp, metallic click of a sidearm being chambered, followed by the soft hum of a tactical optic lens powering on.)*

"Come alone." The oldest lie in the city. If they have the blueprints to this 'New Order,' they have a target on their back big enough to eclipse the moon. And by extension, so do I. 

I adjust the collar of my trench coat against the damp chill, peering through the optic scope at the belfry of the old tower. It’s a relic, standing dead in the center of the industrial district. Perfect for a clandestine meeting. Even better for an ambush. The line between a whistleblower and a corporate assassin has been razor-thin lately, and I've got the scars to prove it.

*(Sound effect: The faint whisper returns, closer this time, brushing against the edge of my hearing. It sounds almost like a name. My name.)*

I freeze. My hand drops instinctively to the cold steel at my hip. I scan the perimeter, switching the optics to thermal. Nothing but rats and the residual heat of the exhaust vents. The weight of this case is getting to my head. The corruption runs so deep it feels like the city itself is breathing down my neck.

"Alright, friend," I whisper into my encrypted comms, leaving a dead-man's switch recording for my own archives. "I'm making my approach. I'll take the blind spot up the south fire escape. If I'm not out in twenty minutes with the data... leak the preliminary files to the press. Let the whole rotten system burn."

*(Sound effect: Bootsteps crunching softly on gravel, fading into the ambient noise of the sprawling, unforgiving city. The ticking of the clock tower begins to grow louder, drowning out the silence.)* 

Let's see what this New Order looks like in the dark.
